_readme: Daily pipeline snapshot history for OutreachEngine MasterInbox workspaces. Appended to by the 'Pipeline snapshot' scheduled task each weekday morning. Source of truth — the oe-pipeline-trend artifact is regenerated from this file. Do not hand-edit unless correcting an error.

_schema.totals: workspace_id -> total thread count (from get_prospects metadata.total)
_schema.labels: workspace_id -> { label_name -> prospect_count }. Currently only 1013 is available; get_label_stats ignores its label_id argument and always returns workspace 1013. When the MCP gains a workspace param, populate this for every workspace.
_schema.churned: workspace_id -> {name, churned_on}. Excluded from the dashboard and from all current counts. Their figures remain in historical snapshots so past totals stay truthful — never strip them from snapshots.
_schema.internal: workspace_id -> {name, reason}. Infrastructure workspaces, not clients. Excluded from the dashboard and all client counts. Distinct from 'churned'.
_schema.taxonomy: Canonical grouping of label names. 'interest' is the funnel entry pool — all three labels are equivalent expressions of interest. 'success' is TERMINAL: a thread ends at Meeting Booked. 'setter_activity' labels are outbound call attempts by the appointment setter, NOT downstream funnel stages — never chain them after Meeting Booked.
_schema.platforms: Sending platforms and their workspace IDs. Three systems: bison_send, bison_personal, instantly.
_schema.mapping_gaps: Known joins that do not resolve between MasterInbox and the sending platforms. Review before trusting any cross-system rate.
_schema.infrastructure_baseline: Input-side (mailbox/domain) observations. Separate from reply-side snapshots.
_schema.client_registry: Authoritative client map from the oe repo's clients.json: MasterInbox ws id, EmailBison ws id, sequencer, per-client MI key env var. Use this for all joins.
_schema.pilot_a1: Results of the first per-client scan pilot. Validates the four-outputs-per-scan design and bounds its cost.
_schema.observed: Per-client scan output: group funnel, domain attribution, awaiting-reply queue. Distinct from 'labels', which is per-label and only available for ws 1013.

snapshots.source: baseline established during manual pipeline review
notes: Full manual review of workspace 1013: 9,161 threads scanned, 29 high-intent threads read individually.
13 threads genuinely awaiting a reply (9 urgent). Automated count of 29 was inflated by calendar mis-threading.
DEFECT: Calendly/Google Calendar mail from our own mailboxes is filed against the wrong prospect record and counted as an inbound reply. Faked 16 of 29 hits.
DEFECT: pricing inconsistency — $3,495/mo quoted to one prospect, $4,995/mo to another, one draft says fee is deal-based not monthly.
DEFECT: 8 of 9 urgent replies had drafts written but never sent.
JUNK: record 'Rosanna Nazir' (rosanna.nazir@vahw.nl) is a phishing digest with a QR-code lure, mislabelled Interested. Should be purged.

snapshots.source: second reading same day — first observed flow delta
notes: Workspace 1013 gained 214 OOO replies, 28 Not Interested, 9 Not Right Now, 3 first-calls-completed, 2 Meeting Requests and 1 Meeting Booked in roughly three hours. This is the flow signal the forecast will be built on.
Savanti Travel (121), Coffee & Contracts (58) and TrueDial (56) not yet sized — capture on first scheduled run.

snapshots.source: churn adjustment — no new data collected
notes: Churned and excluded going forward: AskTuring, Care N Gen, Nuvo Bath, Simplexity, Westlink.
Removes 18,471 threads from the active baseline — Westlink alone was the largest workspace.
Historical totals in earlier snapshots deliberately left intact; the dashboard filters churned clients rather than rewriting the past.
Note: two of the 'eight largest clients' recommended earlier for instrumentation (Westlink, Simplexity) are now churned — that shortlist needs revisiting.

snapshots.source: model correction — no new data collected
notes: CORRECTION: the funnel entry point is the sum of three equivalent labels — Interested, Information Request and Meeting Request — not Meeting Request alone.
CORRECTION: Meeting Booked is the terminal success state; the thread ends there.

CORRECTION: the 'Nth call completed' labels are appointment-setter call attempts, not funnel stages after booking. The earlier reading of '1st to 2nd call = 79% loss' as the biggest revenue leak was wrong — those are dial attempts, not deal progression.

Restated for workspace 1013: interest pool 238 (Interested 37 + Information Request 123 + Meeting Request 78), Meeting Booked 75 = 31.5% interest-to-booked. The previously reported 97% compared bookings against only one of the three interest labels and overstated performance.
INBOXING UPLOADS (329) reclassified as internal infrastructure, not a client. Removes 615 threads from client counts.
The 3 Aug PDF still carries the superseded 97% and 79% figures and needs regenerating.
134 disconnected mailboxes found: Outreach Engine 100 (floor, API-capped), Dream It Reel 20, Abra Personal 13, Intellectible 1.
Dream It Reel fleet is 1,205 connected mailboxes at daily_limit 10 each — roughly 12,000/day of send capacity for one client. Its 20 disconnected are only 1.6% of fleet, so it is NOT dark.
Sending is split across THREE platforms: EmailBison send (16 workspaces), EmailBison personal (7), and Instantly (5). Abra and Intellectible each appear on two.
Campaygn and Ujet have no sending platform on any of the three — either dormant or sending from somewhere unmonitored.
Surety Now exists in Instantly with no MasterInbox workspace; Private Pargo exists in bison_send with no MasterInbox counterpart.
CareNgen (bison_send 35) and Simplexity (Instantly) are churned in MasterInbox but still provisioned on their platforms — worth confirming they are not still sending.
Mailbox-level reporting is not viable at this scale. Domain-level rollup is the only usable unit.

snapshots.source: read oe repo clients.json + .env — authoritative mapping resolved
notes: CORRECTION: Campaygn and Ujet ARE configured and sending — eb_send workspaces 55 and 78. My earlier 'no sending platform found' was wrong.

ROOT CAUSE of the per-client funnel blocker: MI_KEY_* vars live in dev/oe/.env, but the lead-gen MCP serving masterinbox_* is a SEPARATE codebase that does not read that file. LEADGEN_MCP_COMMAND is unset. Restarting cannot help.

emailbison_list_workspaces(send) is INCOMPLETE — returned 16 workspaces but clients.json references at least 23. Missing: 31 AskTuring, 6 Nuvo Bath, 8 Westlink, 54 Union Omaha, 55 Campaygn, 59 Arnon River, 78 Ujet. Do not treat it as a full inventory.

CHURN CONFLICT: clients.json marks Westlink AND Lend Home Improvements churned (Lend Home churned_at 2026-06-01), but does NOT mark Simplexity, AskTuring, Carengen or Nuvo Bath. User-reported churn was Westlink, Simplexity, AskTuring, Care N Gen, Nuvo Bath. Only Westlink agrees. Lend Home is currently ACTIVE in this dashboard — needs a decision.
GAP: 'Built Right' is absent from clients.json entirely, despite MI_KEY_BUILT_RIGHT being set and a bison_personal workspace (team 11) existing. getClient('Built Right') would throw.
GAP: clients.json references MI_KEY_ARNON_RIVER_PARTNERS but that var is NOT set in .env — resolves to undefined, a silent failure.
GAP: Instantly tool enum exposes 5 workspaces but .env.example defines only 3 keys (supply_wisdom, lend_home, surety_now) — intellectible and simplexity have none.

MINOR: MI_KEY_UJET is defined twice in .env. Surety Now is keyed but absent from clients.json. Aunalytics is in clients.json with sequencer 'none' and no MasterInbox. Private Pargo confirmed Bison-only (mi_ws_id null).
COLLISION RISK: eb_ws_id 7 is used by both Savanti Travel (eb_send) and Lend Home Improvements (eb_personal). Any code keying on eb_ws_id without the instance will collide.
RESOLVED: Lend Home Improvements is ACTIVE — the client returned after churning in June. This dashboard was correct; clients.json is stale.
clients.json needs 5 corrections: clear the churned flag on Lend Home Improvements, and add churn flags for Simplexity, AskTuring, Carengen and Nuvo Bath.
Client count unchanged at 19 active. Lend Home (1074, 90 threads) stays in.
Follow-up: the Instantly tool description still calls lend_home '(inactive)'. Confirm which platform Lend Home now sends from — eb_personal ws 7, Instantly, or both.
A1 DESIGN VALIDATED: all four outputs derived from the list payload alone, zero thread reads, 8 data calls for 538 records.
Interest-to-booked across five clients is 32.8% — remarkably close to OutreachEngine's 31.5%. First evidence the conversion rate is structural rather than client-specific.
FOURTH PLATFORM DISCOVERED: HeyReach (LinkedIn) supplies 125 of Clinintell's 208 records. Absent from clients.json. Domain attribution and calendar detection do not apply to it.
Calendar contamination in real clients is 0.19% (1 of 413 testable), not the ~75% seen in OutreachEngine's booked sample. OE is an outlier — my earlier extrapolation would have been wrong.
Thread counts drifted up since this morning's sizing (Ujet 25->31, Built Right 88->90, Arnon 118->119, Clinintell 205->208) — the flow signal is real and measurable.
OutreachEngine at 92 pages is ~19 MB and cannot be scanned in one context. The label_id filter is now the confirmed bottleneck, not a nice-to-have.

platforms._note: Sending platforms feeding MasterInbox. THREE separate systems, not one. Some clients appear on more than one — never sum across platforms without deduplicating.

heyreach.label: HeyReach (LinkedIn) — DISCOVERED 2026-08-03, not in clients.json
heyreach.impact: Domain attribution and calendar detection are undefined for these records. Must branch on the 'source' field.

bison_send._caveat: Outreach Engine returned exactly 100 — almost certainly an API page cap, so 100 is a FLOOR not a count.

api_constraints: get_all_workspace_mailbox_counts WITHOUT a status filter TIMES OUT on bison_send. Always pass a status.
The tool description's '15 mailboxes per workspace hard cap' is wrong when a status filter is used — it returned 100 and 20.
list_email_accounts appears to IGNORE team_id: asking for team 24 returned a 1.4 MB payload of 1,205 accounts.
Per-workspace account lists are far too large to page routinely. Mailbox-level reporting is not viable; DOMAIN-level rollup is mandatory.

client_registry._source: /Users/felipesoza/dev/oe/clients.json — AUTHORITATIVE. Supersedes the name-matching in 'platforms' and 'mapping_gaps'.

_staleness.note: clients.json disagrees with reality in 5 places as of 2026-08-03. Dashboard is correct; the repo is stale.
_staleness.lend_home_improvements: clients.json says status=churned, churned_at 2026-06-01. WRONG — the client returned. Active. Flag should be cleared (or a reactivated_at added).
_staleness.also_stale: Instantly tool description labels lend_home '(inactive)' — accurate now that the client runs on eb_personal. Leave Instantly out of Lend Home's input metrics.
_staleness.lend_home_platform: CONFIRMED: Lend Home now sends via EmailBison PERSONAL, eb_ws_id 7, key env EB_PERSONAL_KEY_LEND_HOME_IMPROVEMENTS. clients.json's sequencer is CORRECT — only its churned flag is wrong. The Instantly 'lend_home' workspace is legacy; do not pull its metrics.
_staleness.list_workspaces_incomplete_both_instance: emailbison_list_workspaces(personal) returned teams 9,16,11,4,3,5,17 and omitted team 7 (Lend Home). Combined with 7 omissions on the send instance, treat list_workspaces as unreliable for inventory on BOTH instances — drive from clients.json instead.

pilot_a1.scope: 5 small clients, 538 records, 8 get_prospects calls, 0 writes

calendar_contamination.verdict: FAR lower than OutreachEngine's booked-thread sample suggested. OE is likely an outlier (dogfood account, Kevin's calendar). Do NOT extrapolate OE's rate to clients.
why_it_is_a_floor: last_reply_address absent on 125 of 538 records (all HeyReach)
'our domains' inferred from channel_id misses the client's real corporate domain — arnonriverpartners.com was missed, hiding 1 booked record
cross-thread bleed exists separately: 2 Clinintell bookings are the same Bronson thread, 2 Arnon bookings share lil.roberts@xendoo.com

drafts.verdict: Drafts skew to last_msg_from='me' — mostly saved copies of sent mail, not pending replies. OE's 'drafts written but never sent' pattern did NOT generalise to these five.

awaiting_reply.notable: Lend Home's 9 are all 46-97 days stale. Arnon Rivers' 20 include 4 that arrived today — a live, healthy queue.

pilot_a1.domain_signal_example: Arnon Rivers: arnonriverpartnersco.digital produces interest but zero bookings across 17 records, while goarnonriverpartners.digital yields 4 bookings from 28.
new_defects: metadata.total returns -1 on pages 2+. Coverage is unverifiable on multi-page scans except via page 1 total plus a short final page.

Duplicate bookings: the same thread appears under two prospect records, inflating booked counts. Material at 3-11 bookings per client. Dedupe on last_reply_address + label set before quoting any booked figure.
Unclassified labels 'Interest' and 'Interest Request' silently drop out of every metric — near-duplicates of Interested / Information Request.

feasibility.outreachengine_1013_projection: 92 pages, ~19 MB, ~500,000 lines — NOT feasible in one agent context
feasibility.unlock: get_prospects honouring label_id. 72% of scanned bytes were unlabelled or pure noise — paid for nothing.

observed._note: Per-client scan results. GROUP-level funnel (not per-label) plus sending-domain attribution and the awaiting-reply queue. Populated by the A1 scan; only clients actually scanned appear here.
observed._no_age_data: Domain registration dates are NOT yet collected, so triage cannot use age and the mortality curve is unavailable. 'warming' is decided on thread count alone. Needs a registrar getDomain pull.
